lyrics:
[Spoken word]
ଗାଁର ନିର୍ଜନ ପ୍ଲାଟଫର୍ମ,
ବରଷୁଥିବା ବୁନ୍ଦାର ଛାଇ,
ରେଳଧାରଣାରେ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ
ଚାଲିଯାଉଥିବା ଟ୍ରେନ୍‌ର ଥରଥର ଧ୍ୱନି।
ଆଜି ପୁଣି ସେହି ସ୍ଥାନରେ
ଯେଉଁଠି ତୁମେ ଛାଡ଼ିଯାଇଥିଲ,
ଆଉ ଏବେ ବି ଅପେକ୍ଷାରେ ଅଛି,
ତୁମେ କେବେ ଫେରିଆସିବ ବୋଲି...।
[End]
title: KBL · କ୍ଷଣିକା · Odia Bare voice
style: Solo female spoken-word recital in Odia (ଓଡ଼ିଆ), native Odia pronunciation and natural everyday speech cadence. Warm, clear, intimate speaking voice at a comfortable register. Quiet literary reading to one listener; restrained longing, never theatrical. Meaning-led breaths with varied pauses, let connected thoughts flow across printed line breaks. A small pause after the passing train; a softer turn at ଆଜି ପୁଣି; leave the last hope unresolved. Preserve Odia vowel lengths and conjuncts; speak each supplied word once in order. Bare dry voice in a quiet room. No singing, tune, chant, rap, beat, music, instruments, whispering, exaggerated breathiness, artificial vibrato, repeated lines, added words, applause or echo. Short complete recital ending in silence.
exclude: singing, melodic vocals, chanting, rap, chorus, backing vocals, instrumental music, percussion, sound effects, autotune, whispering
rationale: Carry the preferred bare-voice treatment to Odia while asking for its own diction, cadence and phrase lengths. Added comfortable register, meaning-led pauses and exclusions for whispering and exaggerated breathiness. No claim to represent a single universal Odia recitation tradition.
